name: Mooseburger Lodge
description: The most popular and beloved restaurant at Six Flags Magic Mountain — Mooseburger Lodge is a wonderfully themed Canadian lodge-style restaurant serving enormous and delicious burgers, loaded fries and classic American comfort food in a fun and atmospheric setting. The best dining experience at any Six Flags park in California.

items.description: The legendary double Mooseburger with special sauce, cheese and fries

items.description: Hand-spun milkshake in chocolate, vanilla or strawberry

name: Carlini's Pizzeria
description: A classic and popular Italian-American pizzeria at Six Flags Magic Mountain serving freshly baked New York-style pizza by the slice and whole pies — Carlini's is one of the most popular and convenient quick-service dining destinations at Magic Mountain.

name: High Octane Wings
description: A popular and energetic quick-service chicken wing restaurant at Six Flags Magic Mountain serving classic American-style chicken wings in a variety of sauces alongside loaded fries and classic sides. One of the most popular casual dining options at Magic Mountain.

name: Panda Express
description: A popular and convenient Panda Express at Six Flags Magic Mountain serving classic Chinese-American dishes including orange chicken, fried rice and chow mein. One of the most accessible and frequently visited quick-service dining options at Magic Mountain.
